cells.document: Sovereign Grace Churches, Statement of Faith
cells.date: Approved by the Council of Elders 10 November 2020; by every Regional Assembly of Elders 30 November 2020
cells.section: God's Sovereign Purposes: God's Grace in Election (see also The Gospel and the Application of Salvation by the Holy Spirit: Effectual Calling, Regeneration, and Conversion)
cells.excerpt: not at all conditioned upon foreseen faith, obedience, perseverance, or any merit in those whom God has chosen
cells.shows: Election is unconditional, and the same statement says God 'effectually calls' the elect and that the response of faith is itself a gift of grace.
cells.binding: Binding on Sovereign Grace Churches: a confessional document owned by all SGC elders. Not binding on Newfrontiers.

cells.document: Newfrontiers, Theological Statement and Core Values of Newfrontiers
cells.excerpt: We see our salvation as a work of God from start to finish.
cells.shows: Newfrontiers names God's sovereignty as foundational and salvation as God's work throughout, but does not spell out unconditional election or effectual calling.
cells.binding: Representative, not a binding confession: the shared values statement of the Newfrontiers family of apostolic spheres.

cells.document: Sovereign Grace Churches, Statement of Faith
cells.section: The Church of Christ: The Sacraments of the Church
cells.excerpt: The sacraments are precious means of grace that signify the benefits of the gospel
cells.shows: The statement calls baptism and the Supper sacraments and means of grace, and says that in the Supper believers 'commune with him and receive spiritual nourishment', while restricting baptism to believers by immersion as a public proclamation of faith.

cells.document: Newfrontiers, Theological Statement and Core Values of Newfrontiers
cells.excerpt: although we believe water baptism is only for believers
cells.shows: Newfrontiers places itself in the tradition of Reformation confessions such as the Heidelberg Catechism, with the stated exception that baptism is for believers only; it says nothing further about the Supper.

cells.document: Sovereign Grace Churches, Statement of Faith
cells.section: The Empowering Ministry of the Spirit: The Gifts of the Spirit
cells.excerpt: the full range of spiritual gifts remain at work in the church
cells.shows: All the gifts continue and are to be earnestly desired and practised until Christ returns, the sole exception being the apostles commissioned as eyewitnesses and recipients of normative revelation.

cells.document: Newfrontiers, Theological Statement and Core Values of Newfrontiers
cells.excerpt: All the gifts of the Holy Spirit at work in the church of the first century are available today
cells.shows: Every New Testament gift is available, vital for mission, and to be earnestly desired and practised; value 5 adds that all Ephesians 4:11 ministries are valid today.

cells.document: Sovereign Grace Churches, Statement of Faith
cells.section: The Church of Christ: The Universal Church (compare The Last Things: Christ's Return and the Resurrection)
cells.excerpt: in continuity with the old covenant people of God but now brought to fulfillment by the work of Christ
cells.shows: The church is one people composed of 'all the elect from all time', continuous with Israel under the old covenant; the Last Things chapter describes a single return, resurrection and judgment and takes no position on the millennium, a rapture or a future for national Israel.
Newfrontiers side: the 2024 Theological Statement and Core Values contains no statement on Israel and the church, the millennium or the order of the last things. None found.

cells.document: Sovereign Grace Churches, Statement of Faith
cells.section: The Scriptures: The Attributes of Scripture
cells.excerpt: Scripture alone is our supreme and final authority and the rule of faith and life.
cells.shows: Scripture alone is the final authority, and the next sentence says all creeds, confessions, teachings and prophecies are to be tested by it; the preamble still confesses the Nicene and Chalcedonian creeds, which fits a coordinate short of the extreme.

cells.document: Newfrontiers, Theological Statement and Core Values of Newfrontiers
cells.section: Core Doctrinal Values, 1. Word-based (with the opening Theological Statement)
cells.excerpt: We believe in the absolute truthfulness, sufficiency and final authority of Scripture.
cells.shows: Scripture is the final authority governing doctrine and church life, while the opening paragraph holds to the four ecumenical creeds as subordinate statements.

cells.document: Sovereign Grace Churches, Statement of Faith
cells.section: The Church of Christ: The Purpose and Mission of the Church
cells.excerpt: the church gathers for the teaching of the Word, prayer, the sacraments, congregational singing, fellowship, and mutual edification
cells.shows: The gathering is defined by a list of elements 'governed by Scripture', ending with the exercise of spiritual gifts, with no set liturgy, calendar or service book named; the statement does not expressly reject fixed forms. (Footnote markers between the listed items are omitted from the excerpt.)

cells.document: 'The 17 points' (the Newfrontiers values associated with Terry Virgo), as published by New Ground Churches, a Newfrontiers apostolic sphere
cells.section: Value on worship (the list is unnumbered on this page)
cells.excerpt: genuine freedom for men and women to worship publicly in the Holy Spirit, to use spiritual gifts
cells.shows: Worship is described as free and participatory, with any member able to contribute through spiritual gifts and 'body ministry'.
cells.binding: Representative, not binding: one Newfrontiers sphere's publication of the movement's founding values. The attribution of the list to Terry Virgo comes from a search result that could not be opened (HTTP 403) and is not verified on the page cited.

notes: This is a two-body family. Sovereign Grace Churches has a genuine binding confession (2020). Newfrontiers has none; its 2024 'Theological Statement and Core Values' is a short values document and is labelled representative throughout.

All excerpts were copied from the pages opened on 2026-09-19 (the SGC page as downloaded HTML; the Newfrontiers PDF read directly; the New Ground page as downloaded HTML). Inline footnote markers such as [18] in the SGC text were dropped; no words were changed. All three documents are recent and in copyright, so every excerpt is under 20 words and marked link_only.

TABLE is the one cell where the documents sit uneasily with the audited coordinate (58, slightly on the memorial side). The SGC statement uses the words 'sacraments' and 'means of grace' and speaks of communing with Christ and receiving spiritual nourishment in the Supper, which is the vocabulary of the Reformed spiritual-presence view, not memorialism; Newfrontiers aligns itself with the Heidelberg Catechism apart from infant baptism. What pulls toward the memorial pole is believer-only baptism by immersion described as a public proclamation of faith. On these documents a coordinate at or slightly left of centre (roughly 40 to 50) would be easier to defend than 58. Flagged for the owner; no data was changed.

KINGDOM: the SGC text supports 'one people' plainly and is deliberately silent on the millennium, which matches a coordinate of 25 (one people, with historic premillennialism tolerated) better than a coordinate near 0. No Newfrontiers document on this axis was found.

WORSHIP: neither body has a document that says in terms 'Scripture prescribes no fixed liturgy'. The coordinate of 85 is supported by description of practice (New Ground value) and by omission (SGC), not by an express confessional rejection of liturgy.

Not opened, so not cited: the Patheos page 'Terry Virgo's 17 Values of Newfrontiers' returned HTTP 403. The date of the SGC approval was read from https://sovereigngrace.com/our-new-statement-of-faith/.
